summary: Steadier backspace suggestions and repaired Scale Improved

changes.title: Hold suggestions during rapid deletion
changes.detail: Keep the last readable suggestion row visible and non-selectable while deleting. Refresh after a 185 ms quiet interval; normal typing remains immediate.

changes.title: Restore visible Scale Improved motion
changes.detail: Use the original Scale snapshot geometry for supported labels while retaining improved logical matching, continuous retargeting and separate opacity. Original Scale timing and rendering stay unchanged.
